title: Thermal management of backside power delivery networks: paper accepted by IEEE IEDM 2026
titleZh: 背面供电网络（BSPDN）热管理研究论文被 IEEE IEDM 2026 接收
body: A paper by the group on thermal management of backside power delivery networks (BSPDN) has been accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Electron Devices Meeting (IEDM). The work presents the first three-dimensional thermal characterization and optimization-oriented reconstruction of advanced logic technologies with BSPDN beyond the 2 nm node. The first three authors — Junliang Fan, Zirou Chen, and Haoyue Huang — are all undergraduate students in the group.
bodyZh: 课题组关于背面供电网络（BSPDN）热管理的研究论文被 2026 年 IEEE 国际电子器件会议（IEDM）接收。该工作首次对 2 nm 节点以下采用 BSPDN 的先进逻辑技术进行了三维热表征与面向优化的重构。论文第一、二、三作者范俊良、陈子柔、黄颢越均为课题组本科生。
